title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The wellbeing of boys, girls and women in the community programme in Syria and Iraq, implemented by Concern Worldwide aims to build the resilience and to improve the wellbeing of vulnerable and conflict affected children, adolescent, adults and children caregivers; through community centre services in North East Syria and Dohuk district, KRI. The activities include supporting children to develop positive emotional and social skills, adaptive behaviours and healthy coping mechanisms; to support caregivers and adults through delivering PSS, and emotional support through group sessions; to provide livelihoods opportunities for adults and caregivers through vocational training; and to provide case management activities to help children and families to overcome protection risks and access services through referrals. OBJECTIVES: Improved wellbeing of children through the assistance of case management in NESOUTCOMES: To improve the wellbeing of boys, girls and women through the creation of community centres in North East Syria (NES) and Dohuk Governorate, Kurdistan Region of Iraq (KRI)
